facts.en: Completed a diploma in Business Records at Fictional Institute D090 in 2021.
facts.zh: 2021 年在虚构院校 D090 完成商业档案专科学历。

facts.en: Worked as a supplier documentation clerk at Fictional Services Office D090 from 2022-04 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2022-04 至 2026-08 在虚构服务办公室 D090 担任供应商文件文员。

facts.en: Maintained supplier names, approved identifiers and document-expiry dates in a controlled register.
facts.zh: 在受控登记表维护供应商名称、获批标识及文件到期日期。

facts.en: Checked required fields against the approved onboarding checklist and recorded incomplete submissions without approving suppliers.
facts.zh: 按获批准入清单检查必填字段，记录不完整提交，不批准供应商。

facts.en: Sent document-renewal reminders using approved templates and routed exceptions to the supplier manager.
facts.zh: 使用获批模板发送文件续期提醒，并将例外转交供应商经理。

facts.en: With the supplier manager, reviewed 180 active records during 2025-08.
facts.zh: 在 2025-08 与供应商经理合作复查 180 条活跃记录。

facts.en: The team found 21 missing expiry dates among those 180 records, recovered 17 from retained documents and left 4 flagged awaiting evidence.
facts.zh: 团队在该批 180 条记录中发现 21 个缺失到期日期，从留存文件恢复 17 个，并保留 4 个标记待证据。

facts.en: Used spreadsheet validation lists and duplicate-identifier checks to maintain register consistency.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格验证列表及重复标识检查维护登记表一致性。

facts.en: Kept change logs with reviewer references and preserved original document versions.
facts.zh: 保留带审核引用的变更记录，并保存原始文件版本。

facts.en: Prepared a 2026-02 renewal-tracking desk guide that the manager approved for team use.
facts.zh: 2026-02 准备续期跟踪桌面指南，由经理批准供团队使用。

facts.en: Drafted a colored-folder proposal in 2026-05; it remained unused and is not an implemented process improvement.
facts.zh: 2026-05 起草彩色文件夹提案；仍未使用，并非已实施流程改进。

facts.en: At the 2025-11 peak, tracked 34 pending renewal requests; the regular 2026-08 queue held 19.
facts.zh: 在 2025-11 高峰期跟踪 34 个待处理续期请求；2026-08 常规队列有 19 个。

facts.en: Completed a 2024-06 spreadsheet refresher using fictional records, separate from the paid supplier work.
facts.zh: 2024-06 使用虚构记录完成电子表格复习课，与有偿供应商工作分开。

facts.en: Volunteered for Fictional Craft Tool Library V090 from 2023-02 to 2023-08 on Saturdays while employed.
facts.zh: 2023-02 至 2023-08 任职期间，星期六在虚构手工工具资料馆 V090 志愿服务。

facts.en: For the library, indexed donated instruction sheets rather than approving purchases or vendors.
facts.zh: 为该资料馆索引捐赠说明页，而非审批采购或供应商。

facts.en: Enjoys making small paper boats and keeps a personal folding journal.
facts.zh: 喜爱制作小纸船，并保留个人折叠日记。

facts.en: Prepared weekly exception summaries without including bank details or unnecessary personal contact information.
facts.zh: 准备每周异常摘要，不包含银行详情或不必要的个人联系信息。

facts.en: Referred requests to change protected fields to authorized reviewers rather than making unapproved edits.
facts.zh: 将修改受保护字段的请求转交获授权审核者，而非未经批准修改。

facts.en: No supplier negotiation, payment approval or legal compliance certification authority is claimed; these are not required by the vacancy.
facts.zh: 不声称具有供应商谈判、付款审批或法律合规认证权限；本空缺不要求这些职责。
